tips.sun: Regular milestone tracking helps catch developmental delays early. Complete a check every month.
tips.mon: Schedule well-child visits early — they fill up fast during peak seasons.
tips.tue: Skin-to-skin contact boosts bonding and helps regulate your baby's temperature.
tips.wed: Reading aloud daily supports language development, even before your baby can talk.
tips.thu: Tummy time is essential for core strength — a few minutes at a time is enough.
tips.fri: Keep a simple daily log of sleep and feeding patterns. Small patterns become big insights.
tips.sat: Trust your instincts. If something feels off, it's always okay to call your pediatrician.
